subject: Cloaker
picture: A cloaker hangs on a dungeon wall like an unfurled cloak facing the viewer. Classic look: two tall wing-sides like a coat, a face in the center cowl with two eyes and a toothy mouth, rib lines on the cloth, one tail hanging from the bottom. Empty cloak, no person, no hanger, no extra legs. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
